_comment: Permission profile for the `workforce` session -- the always-on base of
operations, kept alive by a launchd job and the session the
Claude app talks to. One per machine.
This role is YOURS, not a machine account's. worker and reviewer sessions hold
their own machine accounts; this one is your own seat, and it is where you
It is deliberately NOT the supervisor persona. Supervisor's file is written as a
replacement system prompt that refuses to take work and grants no Edit or Write,
which is exactly wrong for the session you poke from a phone: you would ask it
to fix a typo and get a lecture about not taking items. What IS worth borrowing
is githubRole: none -- an always-on session reachable from a phone should not be
able to push, approve or merge. So: full tools, no forge writes. It dispatches;
what it dispatches holds the tokens.
It can also read the fleet (`wf ls`, `claude agents`) and drive wf, which is the
whole point of it being the base of operations.
